target_phenotype: Morphological cell phenotype — cell and nuclear shape, texture, and intensity features across 5 imaging channels (DNA, microtubules, actin, mitochondria, glycoprotein/membrane)

readout.measurement: High-content fluorescence imaging of fixed cells
readout.instrument_or_platform: Optical pooled screening (in situ sequencing + imaging)
readout.primary_metric: Morphological feature vectors — genes are clustered by similarity of phenotypic profiles across imaging channels

clustering.method: Leiden clustering on PHATE-embedded phenotypic profiles

notes: The only RPE1 (non-transformed) screen. 5-channel readout (DNA, microtubules, F-actin, mitochondria, glycoprotein/membrane). Clusters represent sets of genes whose knockout produces similar morphological phenotypes.
